parole.significato: a cape (sleeveless garment worn by women, which covers the shoulders and arms)
parole.testo: From English cape, from French cape, from Late Latin cappa. Cognate with kappe (“cloak”), kåpe (“cloak”), kapp (“cape, headland”).
